regions.evidence: iNES header: "NES\x1a", 8x16KiB PRG, 16x8KiB CHR, flags $40 => mapper 4 (MMC3), horizontal mirroring; parsed by romatlas inspect (workspace.json).

regions.label: ChrRom
regions.evidence: CHR ROM (128 KiB) declared by the iNES header at file offset $20010; PPU pattern data selected through MMC3 CHR registers R0-R5 by $FF9E/$FFD7 (Y=0..5 from $0500-$0505). Not CPU-addressable, so never 6502 code.

Bank 0 leading 16-bit pointer header ($84AC,$80B0,$949C,...). Never executed: no observed opcode fetch in any scenario (startup, title, password, all 10 password stages, ending); no static JSR/JMP from discovered code targets $8000-$9FFF, all task entry words are >= $A000, and code banks selected into $A000 (R7) are only 3,6,7,8,12,13 (bank 5 only around the sound call).

regions.label: PasswordTable
